audience: developers who run realtime apps on Ably channels

useCases.title: Check which channels have people connected
useCases.text: The AI lists active channels and reads occupancy for one channel: connections, publishers, subscribers and presence members. You see where users are right now.

useCases.title: See who is present on a channel
useCases.text: The AI lists the members present on a channel now, and reads past enter, leave and update events from the presence history.

useCases.title: Read recent messages sent on a channel
useCases.text: The AI reads the history of a channel, newest first, so you can see what was published and debug a message flow.

useCases.title: Review app and account usage over time
useCases.text: The AI reads message, connection and channel statistics for one app or for the whole account, bucketed by time. It can sum up trends.

useCases.title: Audit app setup: keys, namespaces and rules
useCases.text: The AI lists your apps, the API keys with their capabilities, channel namespaces and integration rules. You get an overview of how an app is set up.

useCases.title: Publish a test message to a channel
useCases.text: The AI publishes a message to a channel you name. Every connected subscriber receives it.
